title: Hausdorff measure of a closed ball of an n-plane: H^n(T ∩ B_r(0)) = ω_n r^n
statement: Let N, n ∈ ℕ, T ∈ G(N,n) (T : Grassmannian N n, with n-dimensional linear subspace T.plane ⊆ ℝ^N = Euclidean N) and r ∈ ℝ with r ≥ 0. Then μHE[n](T.plane ∩ closedBall 0 r) = unitBallVolume n · ENNReal.ofReal(r)^n in [0, ∞], i.e. H^n(T ∩ B_r(0)) = ω_n r^n, where H^n = μHE[n] is Mathlib's Euclidean Hausdorff measure on ℝ^N, B_r(0) is the closed ball and ω_n = unitBallVolume n = volume(ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) 1).
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (T : Grassmannian N n) (r : ℝ), 0 ≤ r → (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)) ((T.plane : Set (Euclidean N)) ∩ closedBall 0 r) = unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal r ^ n
